title: Aureline M5 train-comparison record
description: Canonical per-domain train-comparison record minted by the post-launch correction-report and train-comparison lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Turns cross-train post-launch learning into visible program truth: it records the comparison scope a supported-line issue sits in as operators compare one release train to the next — a corrected issue (a supported-line issue a correction packet has shipped a fix for), a remaining narrowed claim (a public claim still held narrower on the current train), or an open exception closure (a backport exception or deferral that still needs explicit closure). Names the comparison scope, binds the resolved line identity, the compared-train reference, the linked correction-packet / defect-ledger-entry / claim-row reference, and the active comparison reason so release/help, support, shiproom, program-governance, and public-proof surfaces can tell which supported-line issues were corrected, which narrowed claims remain, and which exceptions still need closure across trains rather than rereading raw incident tickets. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a train's correction posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
